title: Delivery Timelines
content: Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 business days across major cities. Express 10-minute delivery is available for select catalog items in supported pincodes.

title: Return Policy
content: Unopened products can be returned within 7 days of delivery. Refunds are processed to the original payment method within 3 business days after item inspection.

title: Accepted Payment Methods
content: We accept credit/debit cards (Visa, MasterCard), UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), Net Banking, and Cash on Delivery for orders below 1000 INR.
